clips.title: The story
paras: Rizzle's unguarded plans describe the refining of indurium ore. The scrawls point to the dwarves' dig at Uldaman, in the Badlands, as where the ore comes from, and many of the other notes are about heat resistance. A lump of raw ore sits on the plans as a paperweight, and you carry that sample to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats. This follows Keeping Pace.

Rizzle's schematics describe the refining of indurium ore. Rizzle's scrawls point to the dwarves' dig at Uldaman, in the Badlands, as where the ore comes from. Many of the other notes are about how well it resists heat. A lump of raw indurium ore holds the plans down as a paperweight, and that sample is what you take to Pozzik.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rizzle's schematics describe the process of the refinement of indurium ore. From his scrawls, it is apparent that indurium ore is being obtained from the dwarven excavation site of Uldaman in the Badlands.
Much of the other notes relate to the heat resistant properties.
Used as a paperweight for the plans is a hunk of what appears to be unrefined indurium ore.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Indurium? Interesting... If it is capable of resisting heat to the degree that you say, it would explain the performance increase the gnomes have displayed of late.
This sample you've brought to me will be invaluable, also. I will be able to perform some tests on this, but I'll need more for this to actually be of any use to us.
